newsitem.title: ITALY: Snia Bpd sales in line, sees better 1997.
newsitem.headline: Snia Bpd sales in line, sees better 1997.

text.p: Italian holding company Snia Bpd, part of the Fiat group, posted consolidated turnover of 1.050 trillion lire in the first four months of 1997, in line with 1.048 trillion in the same 1996 period.

For the whole of 1997 Snia expects turnover to be above that of last year, it said in a statement after a shareholders' meeting which approved the incorporation of Fiat chemicals and fibre unit Snia Fibre.
Snia Bpd already owns 83.68 percent of Snia Fibre.
Snia Bpd had 1996 consolidated net profit of 119.7 billion lire against 102.2 billion although parent company profit slipped to 26.3 billion lire from 33.9 billion.
It paid an ordinary dividend of 60 lire against 50 lire.
Group debt at end-1996 totalled 294.6 billion lire versus 394 billion at end-1995.
